title: One of a Kind
narrativeText: The ladder stands fifteen feet tall at ringside. R-V-D climbs it. The crowd holds its collective breath. A Five-Star Frog Splash from the top of the ladder through a table wrapped in barbwire — the most spectacular, dangerous move in extreme history.

choices.label: Take the Leap of a Legend
choices.text: One of a kind. Literally no one else would attempt this.
